Clinical Overview

Understanding Emergency Trauma Care

Serious accidents and injuries need prompt medical attention. Early assessment and treatment can help prevent complications and support better recovery.

At Sanadi Orthopaedic Hospital, our emergency team provides timely care for fractures, injuries, and other orthopaedic emergencies. Patients are assessed quickly and guided to the appropriate treatment based on the severity of their condition.

From emergency evaluation and imaging to fracture treatment, surgery, and post-operative care, our team works to provide the care you need without unnecessary delay.

Emergency Indicators

Conditions Requiring Immediate Trauma Intervention

Seek immediate medical attention after a serious accident or injury, especially if you experience any of the following:

01

Serious Road Traffic Accidents

Major injuries or multiple fractures following a road accident or vehicle collision.

02

Open & Severe Fractures

A broken bone that has caused an open wound or is visible through the skin requires urgent medical attention.

03

Severe Joint Injuries

A joint that appears out of place, is severely swollen, or causes numbness or loss of sensation needs immediate assessment.

04

Neck & Back Injuries

Severe neck or back pain following an accident, especially when accompanied by weakness, numbness, or difficulty moving.

05

Crush & Severe Soft-Tissue Injuries

Serious injuries caused by heavy impact or compression that result in severe swelling, pain, or difficulty moving a limb.

Emergency Protocol

The 5-Stage Trauma Pathway

A clear and coordinated approach to emergency care, from your arrival through recovery.

01

Immediate Assessment

Your condition and vital signs are assessed promptly to understand the severity of your injury.

02

Diagnosis

Appropriate imaging and diagnostic tests are carried out to identify fractures and other injuries.

03

Stabilisation

Pain management and immediate treatment are provided to stabilise your condition.

04

Treatment & Surgery

The appropriate treatment is started, including surgery when required.

05

Recovery & Rehabilitation

After treatment, your recovery is monitored and rehabilitation is planned to help restore movement and strength.

Limb Recovery & Rehabilitation

Helping You Recover After Serious Injury

Emergency treatment is only the beginning. Our team continues to support your recovery with appropriate follow-up care and rehabilitation to help you regain strength, movement, and confidence.
